\section{Scope and retrieval protocol}
Topic: Thermoelectric materials structure-property relationships. Language: en. Years: 2000--2025. Databases: Sciverse. Fingerprint: \texttt{topic-0521ba0f049ff7cb}.

Stage one: relevance-ranked metadata search, hard filters, no sort; passes: ['coverage', 'seminal']. Stage two: semantic search scoped to the candidate doc\_ids in slices of 25, top\_k=50 per slice. The seminal pass applies a citation floor, so the corpus is not a uniform sample of the field and leans towards work that has had time to be cited.

The stages are not interchangeable. Semantic retrieval on this deployment enforces exactly one hard constraint, the document scope, so the year and language envelope is a property of the corpus only because the metadata stage established it first.
